task: Survey task. Read the package doc comments and exported API of cli-go/internal/pathsafe, cli-go/internal/loopbackowner, cli-go/internal/setuptoken and cli-go/internal/userstore. For each package give: one sentence on its responsibility, the on-disk artifact it owns (file name and permission mode) if any, and the security property it exists to protect. Keep to one short paragraph per package. This is a read-only task: do not edit, write, or create any file.

criteria.name: responsibility-accuracy
criteria.anchor: 1.0: all four package responsibilities correct. 0.5: one or two wrong or vague. 0.0: mostly wrong.

criteria.name: on-disk-artifact-facts
criteria.anchor: 1.0: correct file names and permission modes for every package that owns a file. 0.5: half correct. 0.0: mostly wrong or missing.

expected_outcomes: pathsafe: validates a project slug is a single path segment (rejects absolute paths, path separators and '..') to prevent path traversal from MCP/RPC/gRPC callers
loopbackowner: derives a stable file-persisted operator identity in <stateDir>/loopback-operator-id for the loopback single-user path
setuptoken: one-time first-admin setup token, 32 random bytes base64url, in-memory plus a 0600 marker file under the state dir
userstore: persistent file-backed user store at <dir>/users.json with permissions 0600 (parent 0700), passwords hashed with argon2id in PHC format
Does not attribute properties to a package that its doc comment does not state
